We need to list elements that can be definitively identified based on isotope distribution patterns visible in the mass spectrum. We need the mass spectrum data. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra tool to get spectrum. Then analyze isotopic patterns: look for characteristic isotopic spacing and relative intensities indicating elements like Cl (35/37 ~ 3:1), Br (79/81 ~ 1:1), S (32,33,34 with specific pattern), etc. Also C (13C M+1 ~ 1.1% per C). But definitive identification likely limited to elements with distinct isotopic patterns: Cl, Br, S, maybe Si (28,29,30). Use retrieve_isotope_distribution to get patterns for reference.
